brief:
An NBC-aired advertisement comparing an American child who saved $400 for a bicycle with a Palestinian girl who lost her leg in Gaza has drawn attention to U.S. military aid, Shehab Wire reported. The spot places American consumer spending alongside the human cost of the conflict in Gaza.

The advertisement juxtaposes the two children to illustrate the connection between American military assistance to Israel and casualties among Palestinian civilians, particularly children affected by the fighting.

title: American ad contrasts child's bike savings with Palestinian girl's amputated leg
